relationships.statement: "End-to-end tests must exercise the egg page through its public contract, verifying the egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' below it as a visitor sees them, driven by a test runner that checks those outcomes; the test runner and its configuration are not chosen here." depends on "When the page loads and no further action is taken, the word 'Eggs' appears below the emoji in sans-serif text.".
conditions: End-to-end tests verify the word 'Eggs' below the emoji as a visitor sees it, which requires the word to appear below the emoji in sans-serif text
